machines.lede: Other computers that run agents for you, over SSH.
machines.title: Machines
machines.description: Also in the top bar. Every project runs on every machine: pick one under Run on and wisp clones the project there the first time. A follow-up or a rerun can move a task to another one.
machines.none.description: Run agents on another computer over SSH
machines.add.title: Add machine
machines.add.description: A computer you reach over SSH. wisp starts itself there and runs agents on it.
machines.add.name: Name
machines.ssh.title: This computer over SSH
machines.ssh.description: What another computer, or the wisp phone app, needs to connect here over SSH
machines.ssh.server.off: Off: turn on Remote Login (macOS) or start sshd
machines.keys.description.one: {count} key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys. From the other computer, run this once. The phone app shows a command to run here.
machines.keys.description.other: {count} keys in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys. From the other computer, run this once. The phone app shows a command to run here.
